visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Loop Moves One Step at a Time
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Splitting 1 to 7 into chunks of 3 should give [[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7]], but the chunks overlap.

solution.explanation: After taking the chunk that starts at i, the next chunk starts size positions later. Moving only one step makes each chunk start one item after the previous one, so they overlap.
